text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way to the trainer's office, I 
bumped right into Seiun Sky—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
choice_data_list: Aren't you napping a bit too much?
Aren't you napping a bit too much?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
That's totally not it~ Lately, I've just 
gotten hooked on watching videos of chess 
tournaments before bed.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I found myself thinking, "If it were me, 
I'd attack like this..." or "Oh, that's a 
neat trick!" and just got really into it.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
What an incredible clash of offense and 
defense. I'd love to spar with them myself 
someday.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Long before her dreamed-of chess match 
could ever happen, Seiun Sky was already 
about to lose to the sandman.
